+---------------------------------------------------------------+
|                    TREE OF LIFE                               |
|                                                               |
|  LUCA (~3.8 Ga)   ─── Last Universal Common Ancestor          |
|        |                                                      |
|   +----+----+                                                 |
|   |         |                                                  |
| BACTERIA  ARCHAEA                                              |
|   |         |                                                  |
|   |    (some Archaea + some Bacteria)                          |
|   |         |                                                  |
|   |    EUKARYOTA (endosymbiotic merger)                        |
|   |         |                                                   |
|   |         +-- Plants                                          |
|   |         +-- Fungi                                           |
|   |         +-- Animals                                         |
|   |         +-- Other protists                                  |
|   |                                                             |
|   |  Bacteria/Archaea: no nucleus.                              |
|   |  Eukaryota: nucleus, membrane-bound organelles.             |
+----------------------------------------------------------------+
